channel.title: CodeTrust — AI Governance Enforcement Platform
channel.description: Release notes, security advisories, and updates from CodeTrust — the AI governance enforcement platform that prevents unsafe AI-generated code from reaching production.

item.title: CodeTrust v2.7.0 — Signature Engine Hardening, Security Audit Fixes
item.description:
Signature Validator Improvements: Depth-aware argument extraction, min_args/max_args enforcement, commented import filtering, from-import merging.

Autofix Recipe Fixes: fix_mutable_default rewrite (handles all mutable defaults), fix_connection_no_timeout with bracket-depth matching, fix_os_system with shlex.split.

Security Hardening: JWT secret enforcement at startup, auth on governance audit, WebSocket connection limits and idle timeout, org membership authorization, token revocation via Redis, input field max_length, extra=forbid on all models, path traversal protection, OIDC state validation, restricted CORS headers.

Signature Database: 33 modules, 209 functions. 12 new modules added.

1,898 tests passing. 280 rules. 45 API endpoints. 21 MCP tools.

item.title: CodeTrust v2.6.1 — Signature Validation Engine, Extended Autofix, Interactive Demo
item.description:
Signature Validation Engine: Function signature knowledge base covering 16 Python + 11 JS/TS modules. Catches hallucinated functions, unknown parameters, deprecated usage, and provides typo suggestions via Levenshtein distance.

Extended Autofix: 17 new deterministic autofix recipes added.

Interactive Demo: Live browser-based demo at codetrust.ai/demo.html.

item.title: CodeTrust v2.6.0 — AI Governance Gateway, MCP Proxy Tools
item.description:
AI Governance Gateway: 76 real-time interception rules that block destructive AI agent actions before execution. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and Cline.

MCP Proxy Tools: 4 proxy tools (run_in_terminal, create_file, replace_string_in_file, edit_notebook) that enforce governance policies before allowing native tool calls.

Guardian Scanner: Pre-action, mid-action, and post-action code quality scanning with full enterprise rule enforcement.

item.title: CodeTrust v2.5.0 — Enterprise Features, Team RBAC, Billing
item.description:
Enterprise Features: Organization management, team RBAC with admin/member/viewer roles, Stripe billing integration, webhook notifications to Slack and Microsoft Teams.

GDPR Compliance: Art. 15 data export and Art. 17 right to erasure endpoints with append-only audit logging.

Dashboard: Next.js admin dashboard with real-time scan statistics, rule management, and team administration.
